title: RevitCommand
description: Structured representation of a single Revit action derived from a natural-language instruction.

target.description: How to locate the element(s) this action applies to. Required for modify/move/delete/query, omit for create_* actions.

category.description: Revit category to filter by, e.g. Walls, Doors, Windows.

filter.description: Free-text filter criteria, e.g. 'level = Level 1 AND type = Basic Wall'.

host_element_id.description: For create_door/create_window: the ElementId of the existing host wall the new element attaches to. NOT the same as element_id, which identifies the target element itself for modify/move/delete/query actions.

parameters.description: Key-value pairs of geometric or Revit parameter values needed to perform the action.

start_point.description: [x, y, z] in the active project's units.

family_type.description: Revit family/type name, e.g. 'Basic Wall: Generic - 200mm'.

parameter_name.description: Used with modify_parameter: name of the parameter to change.

parameter_value.description: Used with modify_parameter: new value as string (caller casts as needed).

elevation.description: Vertical (Z) position for a level (create_level). Distinct from 'height', which is the height dimension of an object like a wall or door.

confidence.description: Model's self-reported confidence that this structured output correctly captures the instruction.

notes.description: Any ambiguity or assumption the model had to make.
